scripts.content: cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p content --bin content-check -- content --out apps/web/.content/site.json
scripts.images: cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p imgpipe -- content/cats apps/web/public/img/cats --url-prefix /img/cats --manifest apps/web/.content/images.json
scripts.dev: pnpm run content && pnpm run images && pnpm run icons && pnpm run oss && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run content && pnpm run images && pnpm run icons && pnpm run oss && node scripts/cache.mjs start && next build && node scripts/cache.mjs prune && node scripts/fonts.mjs && node scripts/headers.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run content && next typegen && tsc --noEmit
